items: 【Powerful Intel N95 Processor】Equipped with the In tel 12th Gen Alder Lake N95 processor， up to 3.4GHz frequency. Delivers smooth and efficient multitasking performance for work, study, and entertainment.

【Flexible 2-in-1 Design】The detachable magnetic keyboard design allows you to easily switch between notebook and tablet modes to meet your office, study and entertainment needs. Equipped with a 13.9-inch 3K (3000×2000) IPS touchscreen, it delivers crisp, detailed images with vibrant colors. Supporting stylus input, writing and drawing smoothly and precisely stimulates creativity and improves efficiency.

【Dual Cameras & Versatile Connectivity】Built with a 1MP front camera and 5MP rear camera for video calls and photo capture. Includes multiple ports: Mini HDMI, two USB 3.0 ports, Type-C port, DC charging port, and a TF card slot — connecting all your devices with ease.

【High-Speed Storage & Memory】Configured with 16GB DDR4 RAM and PCIe 3.0 NVMe SSD (up to 1900MB/s) for faster data access. Supports TF card expansion up to 128GB, giving you more flexibility for files, photos, and videos.

【Premium Metal Design & Long Battery Life】Crafted with a sleek full-metal body and a 6000mAh battery for extended use. Supports Bluetooth 5.0, Win11, and MS 2024 — offering a portable, reliable companion for everyday use.
